description: This file defines classes and structures for profiling GPU and CPU operations within the MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) framework in PyTorch. It includes profiling info types, methods for starting/stopping profiling, capturing GPU traces, and logging statistics.

classes.name: BaseInfo
classes.description: Base class for profiling information, including type, ID, handle, and timing data.

classes.name: OperationInfo
classes.description: Derived class for profiling GPU kernel or graph operations, including run count and string key.

classes.name: CpuFbInfo
classes.description: Derived class for profiling CPU fallback operations, tracking overhead and operation name.

classes.name: CopyInfo
classes.description: Derived class for profiling memory copy operations, including copy kind and size.

classes.name: CopyStat
classes.description: Aggregated statistics for copy operations, including counts and GPU time.

classes.name: MPSProfiler
classes.description: Main class managing profiling sessions, signpost tracing, GPU capture, and statistics logging.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the profiling info, including timing data.

methods.name: buildTensorString
methods.description: Builds a string describing a tensor's device, type, and size.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns current monotonic time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: buildKernelString
methods.description: Builds a string describing a kernel and its tensors.

methods.name: updateCopyOverhead
methods.description: Updates overhead size based on tensor data.

methods.name: buildTensorString
methods.description: Builds a string for a tensor or buffer, optionally including buffer ID.

methods.name: isStorageOnMPS
methods.description: Checks if a buffer or tensor is stored on MPS device.

methods.name: getCopyKind
methods.description: Determines the copy operation type based on source and destination buffers/tensors.

methods.name: MPSProfiler
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the profiler.

methods.name: beginProfileKernel
methods.description: Starts profiling a kernel or graph handle.

methods.name: beginProfileCopy
methods.description: Starts profiling a memory copy operation.

methods.name: beginProfileCPUFallback
methods.description: Starts profiling a CPU fallback operation.

methods.name: endProfileCopy
methods.description: Ends profiling a copy operation.

methods.name: endProfileKernel
methods.description: Ends profiling a kernel or graph handle.

methods.name: endProfileCPUFallback
methods.description: Ends profiling a CPU fallback operation.

methods.name: StartTrace
methods.description: Starts signpost tracing with specified mode.

methods.name: StopTrace
methods.description: Stops signpost tracing.

methods.name: isCaptureEnabled
methods.description: Checks if GPU capture is enabled.

methods.name: isCapturing
methods.description: Checks if GPU capture is currently active.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Begins GPU trace capture.

methods.name: stopCapture
methods.description: Ends GPU trace capture.
